lines.text: The LORD calls out to everyone who's thirsty: come to the waters, and if you've got no money, come, buy, and eat! Wine and milk without cost, baker. Then He asks why spend money on what is not bread.
He promises an everlasting covenant, His loving devotion promised to Solomon. He made him a witness to the nations, and nations who don't know His people will RUN to them.

wrong_details.wrong: His loving devotion promised to Solomon
wrong_details.true: His loving devotion promised to David

lines.text: Then a call goes out: seek the LORD while He may be found. Let the wicked man forsake his way and return, for He will freely pardon. And the LORD declares His ways are higher than theirs, as the heavens are higher than the earth.
Rain and snow fall from heaven and don't go back without watering the earth. Same with the word from His mouth: it won't come back to Him empty. Baker, that's more than I can say for my cookie jar.
They'll go out with joy and be led forth in peace. The mountains and hills will burst into song, and the rivers will clap their hands. And where the thornbush was, the cypress will grow.

wrong_details.wrong: the rivers will clap their hands
wrong_details.true: all the trees of the field will clap their hands
